title: Nissan 240SX Engines by Year (1989–1998)
description: Every factory engine in the Nissan 240SX by year, 1989–1998: the single-cam KA24E and the twin-cam KA24DE 2.4 fours. The SR20DET was never sold in a US car.
intro: Nissan sold the rear-drive 240SX in the US from 1989 to 1998. Every US car had a 2.4 KA24 four; the turbocharged SR20DET was a Japan-market engine.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
